title: Iman Gadzhi on how his team grew YouTube to 2.6M subs, short form at scale, and why to skip college
summary: Iman explains how a plan-driven content operation (three full-time thumbnail people, constant split tests, a 20-person short-form team) drove YouTube and short-form growth. He also covers setting honest expectations for business beginners, why paid customer acquisition fits software, and why he advises skills and apprenticeships over college.

principles.text: Build content growth from a deliberate plan with set targets, not luck; the team executed to hit specific numbers.
principles.quote: I made a conscious decision that I'm going to have this outcome and I executed on a plan and it got there
